subject.title: agent-core: parallel batch runs a prepared paid tool after the run is aborted mid-batch

question: Which open candidate fix should maintainers land for the prepared parallel-tool abort race?
rationale: Two open PRs close the same issue and target the same agent-core boundary; the source evidence supports the fix shape, but only one branch should become the canonical landing path.

options.title: Land the proof-positive candidate
options.body: Proceed with review and merge for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102276, then close the duplicate candidate and let the issue resolve after merge.

options.title: Use the duplicate candidate instead
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102283 only if they prefer that branch and add comparable proof there.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both PRs if maintainers want a different cancellation architecture than a shared executePreparedToolCall pre-execute guard.

recommendation.title: Land the proof-positive candidate
recommendation.body: Proceed with review and merge for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102276, then close the duplicate candidate and let the issue resolve after merge.
